notes: Start-up and memory are the UPPER edge of what normal runs produced, not one run's best: a single run's best-of-five moved between 282 and 418 ms across six runs of unchanged code, and the first baseline, taken from a low one (331 ms), fired on noise. Memory is from the compiled-steady-state method (cmd package compile -m speed), whose mapped compiled code PSS counts -- 40.4 to 48.1 MB in its first run, against 34-37 MB before it. To be tightened as runs under the current method accumulate. flutter_reference is the runner-speed yardstick for start-up (see runner_slowdown_discount): the upper edge of Flutter's pinned-SDK best-of-five on normal runs (1031-1505 ms through run 35948270531); a run where the emulator is slower than that discounts Codename One's time by the same ratio.
